geeklist.title: Deck the Halls with Boughs of Board Games! A Cleveland Christmas Auction
geeklist.description:
[size=18][i] Deck the halls with boughs of board games, Fa la la la la - la la - la - la. Shelf of Shame, clear the brand names, Fa la la la la - la la - la - la. Kickstarted early, played it… never, Fa la la - la la la - la - la - la. Time to pull the cord and sever, Fa la la la la - la la - la - la.
May your bids be lucky tonight, Fa la la la la - la la - la - la. And your shipping cheap and forthright, Fa la la la la - la la - la - la. Someone wins it, factory sealed, Fa la la - la la la - la - la - la. Shrink-wrap games, still unrevealed, Fa la la la la - la la - la - la.[/i][/size]
[size=18][u]Auction Rules [/u][/size] :d10-1:[b] Bids[/b] - All bids start at just $1 and must be in whole dollar amounts.
:d10-2: [b]No Sniping[/b] - If any item receives bids within the last 3h of the auction ending time, that item remain open for bidding for another 12h. This will keep rolling if the bidding war goes on over a particular item. For example, a bid in the last hour will add 12h to the closing time. Come back in the morning and another last minute bid will extend it another 12h. So on and so on.
:d10-3: [b]Shipping [/b]- The buyer is responsible for actual shipping costs. International bidders are welcome, just be aware that shipping might get hefty, especially on larger items. Most single games will be sent in a [b]USPS Flat rate mailer with tracking[/b] or via most economical option on [b]Pirateship[/b]. Multiple items headed to the same winner can be packed together for reduced shipping cost. Large or specialty items may not combine shipping, please check the individual listings.
:d10-4:[b] Local Pick Up[/b] - If you're in the greater NE Ohio region and would like to arrange for a pick up, we can work that out. There's a handful of sellers who are happy to swap around games and get them to their new home.
:d10-5: [b]Payment [/b]- Paypal, Venmo, or Cashapp is the preferred method of payment, but we can also take cash (if you're doing local pick up).
:d10-6: [b]BGG [/b]- [b]All sales will be processed as a batch through the BGG Marketplace so they get their 3%[/b]. We no longer do individual entries on the bgg marketplace.
:d10-7: [b]Reserves[/b] - Most of the stuff in this auction has no reserve. It'll sell at the highest bid price. Some things have a soft reserve, meaning the seller is not obligated to sell under the price they set, but they might. Finally, some items might have a BIN (Buy It Now) price, meaning a bid of that amount will automatically win the auction on that entry.
:d10-8: [b]Questions[/b] - The individual sellers are watching their own entries. Any questions about an item can either be posted under that item or sent to that seller directly (see the item's poster). If you have any questions about the auction, feel free to reach out to me directly. [size=18][bgcolor=#45c936] Auction Ends December, 20th at 8pm (GMT-5)[/bgcolor][/size]
